messages.subject: ConditionalPanel with multiple selectInputs
parts:
Hello..

In the conditionalPanel function, the first argument is the condition, and the follwing arguments, are Elements to include in the panel.

Is it possible to use a for loop, and generate these elements, or do i have to list them one at a time..

What i would like to do is something similar to:

conditionalPanel(condition, for (i in 1:n) selectInput(inputId_depending_on_i, label_depending_on_i, choices_depending_on_i} )

Thanx
